description: This file defines the SupportsNamespaces interface for catalog operations related to namespaces in Apache Spark SQL connector. It includes method signatures for listing, creating, altering, and dropping namespaces, as well as managing namespace metadata.

classes.name: SupportsNamespaces
classes.description: Interface for catalog implementations that support namespace operations, including listing, creating, altering, and dropping namespaces.

methods.name: listNamespaces
methods.description: Lists top-level namespaces in the catalog.

methods.name: listNamespaces
methods.description: Lists namespaces within a specified namespace.

methods.name: loadNamespaceMetadata
methods.description: Loads metadata properties for a namespace.

methods.name: createNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new namespace with specified metadata.

methods.name: alterNamespace
methods.description: Applies changes to a namespace's metadata.

methods.name: dropNamespace
methods.description: Drops a namespace, optionally cascading to delete contained objects.
